name: University of South Alabama Hospitals

ahrq.src: AHRQ Compendium of U.S. Health Systems, 2023, matched to CMS's hospital list (the site's June 2026 pull)

hc.src: Medicare hospital cost reports (CMS HCRIS, Worksheet S-3), fiscal year 2024 file

subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did USA Health University Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: No other University of South Alabama Hospitals hospital reports more; USA Health Children's & Women's Hospital is next at 1,318. About 8.6 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did USA Health HCA Providence Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 University of South Alabama Hospitals hospitals; USA Health University Hospital has the most, 2,355. About 4.5 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did USA Health Children's & Women's Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 University of South Alabama Hospitals hospitals; USA Health University Hospital has the most, 2,355. About 5.4 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent resident physicians trained at USA Health University Hospital in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent resident physicians trained at USA Health Children's & Women's Hospital in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees do University of South Alabama Hospitals's hospitals have on payroll, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent resident physicians train in University of South Alabama Hospitals's hospitals, added together?
questions.why: 2 of its hospitals report residents; USA Health University Hospital trains the most, 207.

questions.q: What percent of USA Health University Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Traditional Medicare was 13 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 30 percent.

questions.q: What percent of USA Health HCA Providence Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Traditional Medicare was 18 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 27 percent.

questions.q: What percent of USA Health University Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 University of South Alabama Hospitals hospitals; USA Health Children's & Women's Hospital runs highest, 71 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 24 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 0 percent.

questions.q: What percent of USA Health HCA Providence Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 University of South Alabama Hospitals hospitals; USA Health Children's & Women's Hospital runs highest, 71 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 13 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 0 percent.

questions.q: What percent of USA Health Children's & Women's Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: No other University of South Alabama Hospitals hospital runs higher; USA Health University Hospital is next at 24 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 71 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 0 percent.

questions.q: Across all of University of South Alabama Hospitals's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 44 percent.

questions.q: Across all of University of South Alabama Hospitals's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 24 percent.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at USA Health University Hospital in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: No other University of South Alabama Hospitals hospital kept patients longer; USA Health Children's & Women's Hospital is next at 5.9 days. Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: How many hospitals does University of South Alabama Hospitals run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: All of them are in Alabama. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.

questions.q: How many beds do University of South Alabama Hospitals's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.
